cards.title: Walk. See. Grip.
cards.subtitle: RGB-D localization · pretrained RL walking · authored manipulation
cards.detail: Actual simulated G1 physics. Control uses RGB-D, IMU, encoders and contact; known cube geometry/color, camera calibration and pelvis marker. Warehouse racks are decorative replay scenery.
cards.method: Frozen RL walker + authored sensor-driven manipulation

cards.title: One demo. Shifted pickup.
cards.subtitle: Lateral shift recovered · original +4 cm height transfer fails
cards.detail: Same one commanded trajectory and frozen RL walker. Four conditions: nominal both pass; lateral shift and common camera-frame offset only context passes; raised pedestal only fixed replay passes. One episode per condition, no statistical superiority claim. Common-frame offset is not hand-eye calibration.
cards.method: One-demo command retargeting · no gradient updates

cards.title: The height limit.
cards.subtitle: Original transfer misses a pedestal raised by 4 cm
cards.detail: A preserved failure. The sensor anchor was accurate; the warm-start IK solve followed a poor branch and the hand missed. A development-derived multistart repair is evaluated separately, not hidden in these results.
cards.method: Original IK solver · both use same frozen demo

cards.title: GR00T, in its own task.
cards.subtitle: Pretrained VLA + whole-body RL · different task, not a head-to-head score
cards.detail: Actual NVIDIA GR00T-N1.6-G1-PnPAppleToPlate checkpoint and upstream environment. All four recorded episodes are available. First recorded episode is selected, including its failure. No training; SDPA replaces FlashAttention, with numerical equivalence unverified. Different robot hands, environment and task: these counts do not measure relative performance against TensorCode. The upstream whole-body controller reads floating-base simulator state, so this reference does not share the TensorCode sensor-only input boundary.
cards.inputs: VLA: RGB · joints · language / WBC: simulator state
